basis.timestamp: One retained median-seed trace per shape; all streams; 46/16 weighted; completion-chain increments conserve wall.
basis.gpu_idle: Exact union with no recorded kernel/memcpy/memset. Not an HBM counter.
basis.no_major: No major weight/KV-stage kernel resident; glue/vector traffic can remain. Not an HBM utilization measurement.
basis.ramp: Model ceiling: at most one 2.36us fitted ramp per exposed weight/KV stage; glue ramps excluded, clipped to its completion-critical time; first qkv ramp retained, concurrent MoE branches combined. Add only actual GPU idle, not busy DAG gaps.
basis.early: Scenario only: ramp begins at kernel start, then intersect with completion-critical intervals. Actual load issue and PDL wait placement are unobserved by CUPTI activity.
basis.deficit: Unique-read service-equivalent headroom at4.58TB/s; padding/cache/activation reuse and read multiplicity make this an optimistic model, not measured HBM idle.
basis.gap: Per-load contribution: ln(W/(W-bound))/(6 ln(leader/ours)); sums across the six equally weighted log loads.
basis.retained_operands: One store+read per modeled interstage output, excluding b2 returns and one route-ID return store; add final MoE output. HBM service-equivalent scenario, not measured miss traffic. Projection partials included; internal MoE repeated activation reads excluded. Not a strict physical bound on retained-operand latency.
basis.hardware_HBM_idle: Not identifiable from activity timestamps/unique-byte models; no per-kernel DRAM throughput or instruction timestamps are present.
